The '''diplomatic estate''' of [[Consul-General]] [[Dandamont Pring]] was a compound that housed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[consulate]] on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 

The estate was a park-like compound in the outskirts of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[capital/Legends|capital]] [[city/Legends|city]] of [[Drev'starn]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The staff consisted of most of Imperial presence on the planet: 100 low-level [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]], tax-collectors and other officials, such as [[spy/Legends|spies]] and [[slicer/Legends|slicers]]. [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lt. Cmdr.]] [[Janna Tammok]] commanded a token [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] [[Company/Legends|company]] (300 strong), mainly for ceremonial function. 

A [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] and a fleet of armored [[Limousine/Legends|limousines]] served the staff.<ref name="guide" />

The Empire assigned the Consul-General on the planet to coordinate all [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] activities in [[Both system|the system]]. The consulate was equipped with a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transceiver to keep Imperial [[spy/Legends|spynet]] and [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[agent/Legends|agents]] up-to-date. [[Computer/Legends|Computer]] systems had several layers of security, and Tammok's slicers were responsible for them; however inside moles were able to steal some data and sell it to Bothan spies.<ref name="guide" />

Consul-General [[Dandamont Pring]] did not wish to bother with his assignment, and preferred to enjoy the prestige of his position. He maintained a face of good-will, and in order to show the Empire's good face, he threw luxurious parties there, with exotic dishes, rare [[wine/Legends|wines]] and select [[musician/Legends|musicians]]. [[Diplomat/Legends|Diplomats]] and trade representatives received limited invitations and waited in long lists to attend the dances at the park compound. During those receptions there have been dozens of attempted incursions but Tammok's troops successfully detected them.<ref name="guide" />
